prompt:

Varied sportswear colors (charcoal, navy, white, olive, coral), each against a softly blurred Seoul riverside or park background in morning light. Consistent lighting and color across all eight cells.

Everyday anonymous runners in their 20s-30s of mixed pace and body types; faces turned away, in profile at a distance, or too small to identify. No logos on clothing, shoes or objects, no readable text, signage or numbers anywhere, no famous or recognizable landmark (buildings and bridges stay generic and hazy). No illustration, no 3D render, no watermark.
